categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches `src/test/util/common.h` and bears the Tests label, adding core test assertion macros to replace Boost unit test check macros.
categories.rationale: Boost test assertions silently permit incorrect mixed-signedness comparisons to pass and trigger ThreadSanitizer failures when called from secondary threads. Replacing them with thread-safe, compile-time-checked, fail-fast assertion helpers addresses misleading test passes and unblocks assertion reuse in multi-threaded and fuzz testing environments (#34666).
